notes: The verbless ὁ δὲ κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν clause gives the supplied *said* to πρός under rule 62, headed on the prepositional word.
The second attributive τήν is unrepresented and *which is called* goes to καλουμένην (rule 31).
*for one … Saul* taken on Σαῦλον with the supplied *one*; giving *one* to ὀνόματι instead remains defensible and is noted.
Ταρσέα → *a man of Tarsus* headed on *Tarsus*, *man* being the generic completion (rule 66).
